content_html:
Public, cross-platform desktop client for agentic work. One UI that talks to many agent backends through a single provider abstraction — ACP local CLI agents and the Clark runtime — with the performance-critical engine written once in Rust and shared across desktop, mobile, and web.

Standalone Clark CLI and TUI

Clark Desktop is not required. The standalone installer places the Clark-owned clark TUI and its paired native specialist worker in the user's command path:

# macOS or x86_64 Linux
curl -fsSL https://www.clarkchat.com/install.sh | sh

# Open the human-facing TUI in the current project
clark

On Windows PowerShell:

irm https://downloads.clarkchat.com/desktop/cli/install.ps1 | iex
clark

On first interactive use, clark offers browser sign-in, device-code sign-in, or an existing Clark API key. A remote or headless machine can be configured without opening any GUI:

clark login --device-code       # approve from another device
clark login --api-key           # reads the key from a hidden prompt or stdin
clark auth status
clark doctor

CLARK_API_KEY is also accepted for non-interactive CI. It is the cloud credential; the Clark server resolves the account, paid specialist entitlements, and normally the organization. --organization is needed only when the credential can use more than one eligible paid organization. Interactive login persists the credential in an app-owned ChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope and adjacent random key under CLARK_HOME (normally ~/.clark). It does not use Keychain, Credential Manager, Secret Service, or another OS vault. With a TTY, clark opens the TUI. Supplying a prompt runs one headless turn, including the paid specialist workspaces:

clark code "fix the failing test"
clark scout "map this system"
clark security --workflow scan "scan this repository"
clark scientist --workflow discover "test this hypothesis"
clark rsi --workflow create-evals "build a regression eval"

# Reopen the same account-scoped conversation from a script or another machine
clark --conversation CONVERSATION_ID scientist --workflow replicate "continue"

The TUI offers matching Clark Cloud conversations after workspace selection. Desktop, TUI, and headless runs persist the same typed snapshot and specialist binding; the CLI has no separate local session database. Every run fails before starting a worker or model when account-scoped conversation synchronization is unavailable. Specialist execution additionally requires live entitlement, organization resolution, and specialist preflight synchronization. Scientist and RSI completion also requires a verified cloud journal/artifact receipt. Upgrade the verified paired binaries with clark update.

Why

  • Lean by construction. Tauri 2 (native WebView, no bundled Chromium) + a Rust core.
  • One engine, three targets. Transport codec, event projection, and run lifecycle live once in the agent-core Rust crate and compile to native (desktop/mobile) and WASM (web) — instead of being re-implemented per platform.
  • Agent-agnostic, Clark-focused. A trait-based Provider abstraction fronts every backend; the ACP and Clark adapters ride the same trait.
  • Beautiful & complete. React 19 + Tailwind v4 UI: streaming chat, tool-call timeline, plan, permission gates, and an agent "computer" surface.

Architecture at a glance

React (Tauri WebView)  ──invoke/emit──►  agent-core (Rust, native + WASM)
   surfaces, store            │              domain · projection · Provider trait
                              ▼
           provider-acp (JSON-RPC/stdio)   provider-local (native tool loop)   provider-clark (HTTP + SSE)
           local CLI agents via sidecar     local/remote project execution      remote Clark runtime

The same provider boundary can run without the desktop host:

JSONL control ──► code-host (projects · plugins · cancellation · trajectory)
                         │
                         ▼
                  code-worker / coding plugin
                         │
                         ▼
             agent-core::Provider + LocalExecutor

SSH control ──► code-remote (artifact + checksum + credential bootstrap)
                         │
                         ▼
              remote code-worker (model + tools + project)

code-host is provider-neutral and reusable. Workers register typed HeadlessPlugin implementations at their composition root, so research, evaluation, or GPU-specific capabilities can be added without changing the control protocol. See crates/code-worker for the standalone JSONL worker and its fail-closed permission configuration. For a complete CPU/GPU-resident run, crates/code-remote launches that worker over system SSH, verifies the uploaded binary, relays a credential only through encrypted SSH stdin, and exposes correlated ping/catalog/invoke/cancel/shutdown requests. The account-partitioned native runtime registry is the only remote mode; conversations and project inspection attach to its opaque worker capabilities.

Autoregressive prompt & schema design

LLMs generate left-to-right, so order is part of the prompt. The local coding agent (crates/provider-local) is designed around that:

  • Tool schemas are ordered prompts. The model emits tool-call arguments in the property order the schema advertises, so every schema is authored locate-before-payload (edit_file: path → old_string → new_string), decide-before-write (memory: action → scope → title → content), and rationale-first (update_plan: explanation → plan). The workspace enables serde_json's preserve_order feature so authored order actually reaches the wire — stock serde_json alphabetizes json!{} maps, which had silently reversed edit_file into new_string → old_string → path. A regression test pins the wire order of the sensitive schemas.
  • The system prompt is position-aware. Hard rules (the shared-worktree git rules) sit in the primacy slot directly after the identity line; volatile per-turn facts (a fresh git status snapshot, output style) are injected at the recency end of each turn message — which also keeps the cached system prompt prefix stable for prompt caching.

Layout

Path What
crates/agent-core Domain model, projection reducers, Provider trait, codecs. Native + WASM.
crates/provider-acp Agent Client Protocol adapter (JSON-RPC over stdio).
crates/provider-clark Clark runtime adapter: HTTP command writes (/api/conversation-sync/commands) + resumable SSE event stream, with a WS for realtime session binding.
crates/provider-local Local coding loop with brokered Clark Cloud tools and a default-on native command sandbox.
crates/code-host Reusable headless control plane: strict JSONL protocol, project registry, plugin interfaces, cancellation, and durable trajectory.
crates/code-worker Standalone clark-code-worker composition root with the first-party coding plugin over provider-local.
crates/code-remote Reusable SSH launcher/control client for worker-resident model/tool execution, versioned artifacts, checksum verification, credential bootstrap, and reconnect-safe request correlation.
crates/exec-sandbox* Cross-platform policy, Seatbelt/bubblewrap adapters, and the Windows restricted-token privilege boundary. See sandbox design.
crates/devbridge Dev-only WebSocket bridge that drives the real providers + projection from a browser (headless UI testing, video capture). Not shipped.
src-tauri Tauri 2 host: commands, event bridge, sidecar, state.
app Vite + React + TS + Tailwind v4 frontend.
harness Playwright scripts for local smoke runs, diagnostics, and screen capture against the running app.

Develop

Prerequisites: Rust (stable), Node 24+, pnpm 10+, and the Tauri 2 system deps.

# Rust engine: test + lint
cargo test -p agent-core -p provider-acp -p provider-clark -p provider-local
cargo clippy -p agent-core -p provider-acp -p provider-clark -p provider-local -p devbridge --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --all --check

# Frontend (browser preview uses a mock provider)
cd app && pnpm install && pnpm dev      # http://localhost:1420
pnpm test                               # vitest
pnpm typecheck

# Run the desktop app with the isolated, stably signed development identity
./script/build_and_run.sh

Owner-local capture

The native host and React error boundaries write the shared Clark Capture v1 event format when CLARK_CAPTURED_LOGS points to an absolute, non-symlinked directory. The development launcher enables it at $CLARK_LOGS/captured by default and restricts the directory to the current owner (0700). Normal release launches remain opt-in through the environment variable.

export CLARK_CAPTURED_LOGS="$HOME/Library/Logs/ClarkCapture"
./script/build_and_run.sh

# From an installed clark-capture analyzer:
clark-capture latest --project clark-desktop --level error -n 20
clark-capture dedup --project clark-desktop --mode semantic --since 24h

Existing Rust tracing events and native panics are captured directly. Browser errors, unhandled rejections, and contained React failures cross a typed Tauri boundary as an opaque reference plus message-free stack frames; raw exception messages, conversation content, credentials, and request bodies are not copied to disk. Capture failures never interrupt the application.

In a plain browser the UI runs against a mock provider that plays a scripted streaming run, so every surface is demonstrable without the native host.

Resilience benchmark

The Playwright resilience benchmark drives the real Clark Code conversation UI through every combination of six independent conditions: rate limiting, duplicated provider tool-call IDs, event-stream disconnects, provider-process loss, delayed cloud-history acknowledgment, and explicit user cancellation. That is a deterministic 64-case power set, not 64 paid model calls. Each case asserts that the conversation stays rendered, internal tool-call IDs remain hidden, incident state settles, and interrupted/cancelled work can continue from saved progress. Screenshots and a JSON receipt are written to a temporary artifact directory printed at the end of the run.

cd harness
node resilience-benchmark.mjs

For a quick representative pass, --smoke runs the healthy baseline, each of the six faults in isolation, and the all-faults interaction case:

cd harness
node resilience-benchmark.mjs --smoke

A separate control drives the real local provider through devbridge using the included Clark-managed clark-code:free route backed by DeepSeek V4 Flash Latest. It is intentionally opt-in because it makes live model calls against the account's included weekly allowance. Set CLARK_CODE_API_KEY (or keep it in the repository's gitignored .env) and run:

cd harness
node resilience-benchmark.mjs --live-only

The shared contract in app/src/core-bridge/resilienceBenchmark.json pins the matrix dimensions, provider, and model for both the TypeScript tests and Playwright harness so the reported configuration cannot drift from the simulated one.

Pre-release experience benchmark

Every release build is gated on a fast cross-product sample: core event and provider contracts; native desktop commands, account boundaries, and local persistence; local tools, permissions, memory, planning, and recovery; scripted conversations; remote execution, git, and worktrees; frontend state and surfaces; computer-use safety and simulator contracts; macOS, Linux, and Windows sandbox contracts; WebKit startup; attachment rendering; an eight-case browser resilience sample; and the full empty-home skill experience. The wrapper executes the authoritative deterministic lanes from the checked-in feature map first, so a new mapped lane cannot remain a documentation-only claim. The skill lane covers legacy-compatible discovery, managed Superpowers install, collision-safe selection, typed history, provider request projection, update/stale-binding handling, restart, uninstall, and the same lifecycle against a fake remote user home. It runs against both a self-contained fixture and a pinned real Superpowers checkout, then uploads one suite receipt, the detailed skill receipt, browser screenshots, and per-family logs.

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --superpowers /path/to/obra/superpowers

A representative paid real-model lane is part of the same gate by default. It uses the pinned Clark Platform Qwen 3.7 Flash route and exercises a managed skill resource, basic response, read/search tools, permissioned mutation, a memory round trip, and explicit compaction/continuation. Provider, endpoint, and model are pinned; only the credential is local:

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --superpowers /path/to/obra/superpowers

The runner also reads CLARK_CODE_API_KEY from the ignored repository .env without executing the file. Use --offline for an explicit deterministic-only run. Tag releases default to the paid lane and require the CLARK_CODE_PRERELEASE_API_KEY repository secret; set the CLARK_CODE_PRERELEASE_LIVE repository variable to 0 only for a deliberate offline release gate. Missing or invalid live configuration fails before builds or publishing instead of silently skipping the paid evidence.

Before cross-repository, UTM, or SSH work, use the redacted environment preflight. It discovers the existing ignored Desktop and Clark env files, checks their permissions, validates utmctl, exact QA guests, SSH reachability, and the remote-worker configuration without printing credentials. Remote host, root, trajectory, and HTTPS route have safe defaults; only the worker, credential environment, paid model, and receipt path must be supplied for the remote lane:

node harness/release-environment-preflight.mjs --all \
  --out target/release-preflight/all

harness/clark-code-feature-map.json and harness/clark-code-capability-inventory.json are the checked-in coverage contract. node harness/feature-matrix.mjs --validate-only derives model tools, native commands, provider operations, models, settings, plugins, workspace crates, permission classes, sandbox backends, computer actions, and incident states from source; adding an unmapped item makes validation fail. Benchmark directories and receipts are created owner-only.

UTM guest readiness

Windows and Ubuntu Desktop real-use testing uses UTM only. VM provisioning, login, guest transport, source staging, native product launch, Clark-owned QA authentication, evidence capture, and recovery are autonomous release prerequisites: every receipt must report required_user_vm_actions: 0 and manual_vm_actions_allowed: false. A physical-human input path is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy a release gate.

The deterministic guest path is:

node harness/utm-autonomy.mjs ensure --platform all
node harness/utm-source-stage.mjs stage --platform all
node harness/utm-guest-provision.mjs ensure --platform all
node harness/utm-guest-benchmark.mjs run --offline --platform all
node harness/utm-windows-journey.mjs auth-smoke
node harness/utm-ubuntu-journey.mjs auth-smoke

The auth journeys mint a short-lived session for the ignored, owner-only Clark QA identity, require the clarkslabs.com domain, verify that the provisioned Clark Code key is bound to the same account, and never write the email, password, JWT, or API key into a receipt.

The read-only preflight never starts, stops, installs, or changes a VM; it verifies the exact checked-in VM identities, guest-agent connectivity, graphical desktop state, Clark Code installation, and each platform's sandbox prerequisite:

node harness/utm-real-use.mjs \
  --platform all \
  --observation-receipt target/utm-real-use-observations/DATE/receipt.json \
  --out target/utm-real-use/preflight

Pass the same observation receipt to the consolidated gate to make both guests release-blocking:

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --utm-observation-receipt target/utm-real-use-observations/DATE/receipt.json

An environment-ready receipt is only permission to begin guest testing. It does not count any Windows or Ubuntu chat, job, computer-control, permission, or sandbox scenario as passed; those require separately exported real guest receipts. If either guest is unready, the consolidated runner records the exact blocker and skips its default cheapest-paid calls so no credits are spent against a known-broken environment.

Once a guest is ready, generate its exact observation template inside that guest, replace every blocker with fresh GUI assertions and evidence, and run the platform benchmark:

node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \
  --write-observation-template target/real-use-observation.json

node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \
  --observation-receipt target/real-use-observation.json \
  --out target/platform-real-use

The second command must run on the platform it claims. It validates every scenario and evidence hash before spending credits, then runs all applicable deterministic lanes plus the pinned Clark Platform Qwen 3.7 Flash route by default. A complete pass requires all mapped real-use scenarios, a positive cost below the checked-in ceiling, and no stored credential. --offline remains useful for diagnosis but cannot produce a complete guest pass. Exported packages can be independently verified and copied without model calls:

node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \
  --verify-receipt target/platform-real-use/receipt.json \
  --copy-to target/verified-platform-real-use

To make cross-platform real use part of the single release receipt, pass one verified package from each platform. Supplying any package makes the complete three-platform set and the current UTM preflight release-blocking:

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --utm-observation-receipt target/utm-observation/receipt.json \
  --real-use-receipt target/macos-real-use/receipt.json \
  --real-use-receipt target/windows-real-use/receipt.json \
  --real-use-receipt target/ubuntu-real-use/receipt.json

Repository Status

Clark Desktop is open source under the Apache-2.0 license. The local ACP and provider-local paths can be developed without Clark Cloud access; Clark provider, specialist, release, and hosted-worker paths require the corresponding Clark services and credentials. Do not commit credentials, customer data, screenshots from authenticated environments, or generated release artifacts.

This is a clean-room implementation: no code from the main Clark repository is copied into this client; shared behavior is reimplemented against provider contracts. See CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md before opening a pull request or reporting a vulnerability.

The read-only preflight never starts, stops, installs, or changes a VM; it verifies the exact checked-in VM identities, guest-agent connectivity, graphical desktop state, Clark Code installation, and each platform's sandbox prerequisite: node harness/utm-real-use.mjs \ --platform all \ --observation-receipt target/utm-real-use-observations/DATE/receipt.json \ --out target/utm-real-use/preflight Pass the same observation receipt to the consolidated gate to make both guests release-blocking: ./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \ --utm-observation-receipt target/utm-real-use-observations/DATE/receipt.json An environment-ready receipt is only permission to begin guest testing. It does not count any Windows or Ubuntu chat, job, computer-control, permission, or sandbox scenario as passed; those require separately exported real guest receipts. If either guest is unready, the consolidated runner records the exact blocker and skips its default cheapest-paid calls so no credits are spent against a known-broken environment. Once a guest is ready, generate its exact observation template inside that guest, replace every blocker with fresh GUI assertions and evidence, and run the platform benchmark: node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \ --write-observation-template target/real-use-observation.json node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \ --observation-receipt target/real-use-observation.json \ --out target/platform-real-use The second command must run on the platform it claims. It validates every scenario and evidence hash before spending credits, then runs all applicable deterministic lanes plus the pinned Clark Platform Qwen 3.7 Flash route by default. A complete pass requires all mapped real-use scenarios, a positive cost below the checked-in ceiling, and no stored credential. --offline remains useful for diagnosis but cannot produce a complete guest pass. Exported packages can be independently verified and copied without model calls: node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \ --verify-receipt target/platform-real-use/receipt.json \ --copy-to target/verified-platform-real-use To make cross-platform real use part of the single release receipt, pass one verified package from each platform. Supplying any package makes the complete three-platform set and the current UTM preflight release-blocking: ./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \ --utm-observation-receipt target/utm-observation/receipt.json \ --real-use-receipt target/macos-real-use/receipt.json \ --real-use-receipt target/windows-real-use/receipt.json \ --real-use-receipt target/ubuntu-real-use/receipt.json Repository Status Clark Desktop is open source under the Apache-2.0 license. The local ACP and provider-local paths can be developed without Clark Cloud access; Clark provider, specialist, release, and hosted-worker paths require the corresponding Clark services and credentials. Do not commit credentials, customer data, screenshots from authenticated environments, or generated release artifacts. This is a clean-room implementation: no code from the main Clark repository is copied into this client; shared behavior is reimplemented against provider contracts. See CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md before opening a pull request or reporting a vulnerability.

blocks.html_en: • Tool schemas are ordered prompts. The model emits tool-call arguments in the property order the schema advertises, so every schema is authored locate-before-payload (edit_file: path → old_string → new_string), decide-before-write (memory: action → scope → title → content), and rationale-first (update_plan: explanation → plan). The workspace enables serde_json's preserve_order feature so authored order actually reaches the wire — stock serde_json alphabetizes json!{} maps, which had silently reversed edit_file into new_string → old_string → path. A regression test pins the wire order of the sensitive schemas.

sentences.en: The model emits tool-call arguments in the property order the schema advertises, so every schema is authored locate-before-payload (edit_file: path → old_string → new_string), decide-before-write (memory: action → scope → title → content), and rationale-first (update_plan: explanation → plan).
sentences.zh: 该模型按照模式广告的属性顺序发出工具调用参数，因此每个模式都是在有效负载之前定位（编辑文件：路径→旧字符串→新字符串）、写入之前决定（内存：操作→范围→标题→内容）和原理优先（更新计划：解释→计划）来编写的。

sentences.en: The workspace enables serde_json's preserve_order feature so authored order actually reaches the wire — stock serde_json alphabetizes json!{} maps, which had silently reversed edit_file into new_string → old_string → path.

content_html_zh:
用于代理工作的公共跨平台桌面客户端。 一种 UI，通过单一提供程序抽象（ACP 本地 CLI 代理和 Clark 运行时）与许多代理后端进行通信，性能关键引擎用 Rust 编写一次，并在桌面、移动和 Web 之间共享。

独立的 Clark CLI 和 TUI

不需要 Clark 桌面。 独立安装程序将 Clark 拥有的 clark TUI 及其配对的本机专家工作人员放置在用户的命令路径中：

# macOS or x86_64 Linux
curl -fsSL https://www.clarkchat.com/install.sh | sh

# Open the human-facing TUI in the current project
clark

在 Windows PowerShell 上：

irm https://downloads.clarkchat.com/desktop/cli/install.ps1 | iex
clark

首次交互使用时，clark 提供浏览器登录、设备代码登录或现有 Clark API 密钥。 无需打开任何 GUI 即可配置远程或无头计算机：

clark login --device-code       # approve from another device
clark login --api-key           # reads the key from a hidden prompt or stdin
clark auth status
clark doctor

非交互式 CI 也接受 CLARK_API_KEY。 是云凭证； Clark 服务器解析帐户、付费专家权限以及通常的组织。 --仅当凭证可以使用多个符合条件的付费组织时才需要组织。 交互式登录将凭证保留在应用程序拥有的 ChaCha20-Poly1305 信封中，并在 CLARK_HOME（通常为 ~/.clark）下相邻的随机密钥中。 它不使用钥匙串、凭证管理器、特勤局或其他操作系统库。 克拉克通过 TTY 打开 TUI。 提供提示即可无头运行，包括付费专家工作区：

clark code "fix the failing test"
clark scout "map this system"
clark security --workflow scan "scan this repository"
clark scientist --workflow discover "test this hypothesis"
clark rsi --workflow create-evals "build a regression eval"

  • 通过建设精益。 Tauri 2（原生 WebView，无捆绑 Chromium）+ Rust 核心。
  • 一台发动机，三个目标。 在代理核心 Rust 箱中传输编解码器、事件投影和运行生命周期一次，并编译为本机（桌面/​​移动）和 WASM（Web）——而不是在每个平台上重新实现。

  • 美丽而完整。 React 19 + Tailwind v4 UI：流式聊天、工具调用时间线、计划、权限门和代理“计算机”界面。

自回归提示和模式设计

LLM 生成从左到右的顺序，因此顺序是提示的一部分。 本地编码代理（crates/provider-local）是围绕以下内容设计的：

  • 工具模式是有序的提示。 该模型按照模式广告的属性顺序发出工具调用参数，因此每个模式都是在有效负载之前定位（编辑文件：路径→旧字符串→新字符串）、写入之前决定（内存：操作→范围→标题→内容）和原理优先（更新计划：解释→计划）来编写的。 工作区启用了 serde_json 的preserve_order 功能，因此编写的顺序实际上到达了线路 — stock serde_json 按字母顺序排列 json!{} 映射，该映射已默默地将 edit_file 反转为 new_string → old_string → 路径。 回归测试固定敏感模式的线序。
  • 系统提示符具有位置感知功能。 硬规则（共享工作树 git 规则）位于身份线之后的首要位置；每回合易失性事实（新的 git 状态快照、输出样式）在每个回合消息的新近度结束时注入 - 这也使缓存的系统提示前缀保持稳定，以进行提示缓存。

所有者本地捕获

当 CLARK_CAPTURED_LOGS 指向绝对的非符号链接目录时，本机主机和 React 错误边界会写入共享的 Clark Capture v1 事件格式。 开发启动器默认在 $CLARK_LOGS/captured 启用它，并将目录限制为当前所有者 (0700)。 正常发布发布仍然通过环境变量选择加入。

export CLARK_CAPTURED_LOGS="$HOME/Library/Logs/ClarkCapture"
./script/build_and_run.sh

# From an installed clark-capture analyzer:
clark-capture latest --project clark-desktop --level error -n 20
clark-capture dedup --project clark-desktop --mode semantic --since 24h

直接捕获现有的 Rust 跟踪事件和本机恐慌。 浏览器错误、未处理的拒绝和包含的 React 失败作为不透明引用加上无消息堆栈框架跨越类型化的 Tauri 边界；原始异常消息、对话内容、凭据和请求正文不会复制到磁盘。 捕获失败永远不会中断应用程序。

在普通浏览器中，UI 针对模拟提供程序运行，该模拟提供程序播放脚本化流运行，因此每个表面都可以在没有本机主机的情况下进行演示。

弹性基准

Playwright 弹性基准通过六个独立条件的每种组合来驱动真正的 Clark Code 对话 UI：速率限制、重复的提供商工具调用 ID、事件流断开连接、提供商进程丢失、延迟的云历史记录确认和显式用户取消。 这是确定性的 64 例幂集，而不是 64 次付费模型调用。 每个案例都断言对话保持渲染状态，内部工具调用 ID 保持隐藏，事件状态稳定，并且中断/取消的工作可以从保存的进度继续。 屏幕截图和 JSON 收据将写入运行结束时打印的临时工件目录。

cd harness
node resilience-benchmark.mjs

对于快速代表性传递，--smoke 运行健康基线、隔离的六个故障中的每一个以及所有故障交互情况：

cd harness
node resilience-benchmark.mjs --smoke

一个单独的控件使用包含的 Clark 管理的 clark-code：由 DeepSeek V4 Flash 最新版本支持的免费路由，通过 devbridge 驱动真正的本地提供商。 它是有意选择加入的，因为它根据帐户包含的每周津贴进行实时模型调用。 设置 CLARK_CODE_API_KEY （或将其保存在存储库的 gitignored .env 中）并运行：

cd harness
node resilience-benchmark.mjs --live-only

app/src/core-bridge/resilienceBenchmark.json 中的共享合约固定了 TypeScript 测试和 Playwright 工具的矩阵维度、提供程序和模型，因此报告的配置不会与模拟的配置发生偏差。

预发布体验基准

每个版本构建都基于快速跨产品样本：核心事件和提供商合同；本机桌面命令、帐户边界和本地持久性；本地工具、权限、内存、规划和恢复；有脚本的对话；远程执行、git 和工作树；前端状态和表面；计算机使用安全和模拟器合同； macOS、Linux 和 Windows 沙箱合约； WebKit启动；附件渲染；八个案例的浏览器弹性示例；以及完整的空家技能体验。 包装器首先从签入的特征图中执行权威的确定性车道，因此新的映射车道不能保留为仅文档声明。 技能通道涵盖旧版兼容发现、托管超级能力安装、碰撞安全选择、键入历史记录、提供者请求投影、更新/过时绑定处理、重新启动、卸载以及针对假远程用户主目录的相同生命周期。 它针对独立的固定装置和固定的真实超级大国结帐运行，然后上传一套收据、详细的技能收据、浏览器屏幕截图和每个家庭的日志。

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --superpowers /path/to/obra/superpowers

默认情况下，代表性付费实模型车道是同一登机口的一部分。 它使用固定的 Clark Platform Qwen 3.7 Flash 路线，并使用托管技能资源、基本响应、读取/搜索工具、许可突变、内存往返和显式压缩/延续。 提供者、端点和模型已固定；只有凭证是本地的：

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --superpowers /path/to/obra/superpowers

运行程序还会从被忽略的存储库 .env 中读取 CLARK_CODE_API_KEY 而不执行该文件。 使用 --offline 进行明确的仅确定性运行。 标签发布默认为付费通道，并需要 CLARK_CODE_PRERELEASE_API_KEY 存储库密钥；仅针对有意的​​离线发布门将 CLARK_CODE_PRERELEASE_LIVE 存储库变量设置为 0。 丢失或无效的实时配置在构建或发布之前失败，而不是默默地跳过付费证据。

在跨存储库、UTM 或 SSH 工作之前，请使用经过编辑的环境预检。 它会发现现有的被忽略的 Desktop 和 Clark env 文件，检查其权限，验证 utmctl、精确的 QA 来宾、SSH 可访问性以及远程工作人员配置，而无需打印凭据。 远程主机、根、轨迹、HTTPS路由都有安全默认值；只需为远程通道提供工作人员、凭证环境、付费模型和收据路径：

node harness/release-environment-preflight.mjs --all \
  --out target/release-preflight/all

harness/clark-code-feature-map.json 和harness/clark-code-capability-inventory.json 是签入的覆盖范围合同。 nodeharness/feature-matrix.mjs --validate-only 从源中派生模型工具、本机命令、提供程序操作、模型、设置、插件、工作区板条箱、权限类、沙箱后端、计算机操作和事件状态；添加未映射的项目会使验证失败。 基准目录和收据仅由所有者创建。

UTM 访客准备就绪

Windows 和 Ubuntu 桌面实际使用测试仅使用 UTM。 VM 配置、登录、来宾传输、源暂存、本机产品启动、Clark 拥有的 QA 身份验证、证据捕获和恢复是自主发布的先决条件：每个收据必须报告 required_user_vm_actions: 0 和 manual_vm_actions_allowed: false。 物理-人类输入路径仅是诊断性的，不能满足释放门。

确定性访客路径为：

node harness/utm-autonomy.mjs ensure --platform all
node harness/utm-source-stage.mjs stage --platform all
node harness/utm-guest-provision.mjs ensure --platform all
node harness/utm-guest-benchmark.mjs run --offline --platform all
node harness/utm-windows-journey.mjs auth-smoke
node harness/utm-ubuntu-journey.mjs auth-smoke

只读预检永远不会启动、停止、安装或更改虚拟机；它验证准确的签入虚拟机身份、来宾代理连接、图形桌面状态、Clark 代码安装以及每个平台的沙箱先决条件：

node harness/utm-real-use.mjs \
  --platform all \
  --observation-receipt target/utm-real-use-observations/DATE/receipt.json \
  --out target/utm-real-use/preflight

将相同的观察收据传递到综合门以使两位客人释放阻塞：

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --utm-observation-receipt target/utm-real-use-observations/DATE/receipt.json

环境就绪收据只是开始访客测试的许可。 它不会将任何 Windows 或 Ubuntu 聊天、作业、计算机控制、权限或沙箱场景视为已通过；这些需要单独导出真实的客人收据。 如果任一来宾尚未准备好，整合的运行程序会记录确切的阻止者并跳过其默认的最便宜付费呼叫，因此不会针对已知损坏的环境花费任何积分。

一旦来宾准备就绪，就在该来宾内生成其精确的观察模板，用新的 GUI 断言和证据替换每个阻止程序，并运行平台基准测试：

node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \
  --write-observation-template target/real-use-observation.json

node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \
  --observation-receipt target/real-use-observation.json \
  --out target/platform-real-use

第二个命令必须在它声明的平台上运行。 它在花费积分之前验证每个场景和证据哈希，然后运行所有适用的确定性通道以及默认固定的 Clark Platform Qwen 3.7 Flash 路线。 完整的通行证需要所有映射的实际使用场景、低于签入上限的正成本，并且不需要存储凭证。 --offline 对于诊断仍然有用，但无法生成完整的访客通行证。 导出的包可以独立验证和复制，无需模型调用：

node harness/platform-real-use.mjs \
  --verify-receipt target/platform-real-use/receipt.json \
  --copy-to target/verified-platform-real-use

为了使跨平台真正使用单一发布收据的一部分，请从每个平台传递一个经过验证的包。 提供任何软件包都会构成完整的三平台集和当前的 UTM 预检发布阻止：

./scripts/run-pre-release-benchmarks.sh \
  --utm-observation-receipt target/utm-observation/receipt.json \
  --real-use-receipt target/macos-real-use/receipt.json \
  --real-use-receipt target/windows-real-use/receipt.json \
